policy.zones: 1h/4h single base candle range <=0.8 preceding ATR14, followed by departure body >=1.5 ATR and close beyond the base. Zone known only at departure close.
policy.entry: First later 5m touch of fresh zone, with directional candle closing beyond proximal boundary. No gamma, options flow or LSTM requirement. No historical signal backfill.
policy.stop: Outer low for LONG / high for SHORT of latest completed session-anchored 1h and 4h bars known at decision.
policy.same_bar_stop_and_target: Stop first, conservatively; intrabar order unknown.
policy.accounts: Separate 100000 USD QQQ and 100000 EUR EXS1.DE paper subaccounts. Never sum native currencies.
policy.limits: Experimental fixed rules, unvalidated profitability. Yahoo can be delayed. OHLC fills are illustrative; no spread, borrow fee, dividend liability or real short availability model.
